REJECT

Moving only the if/else, guard check and ternary into helpers removes about 14 points, so the remaining `ExpressAndFastify` likely lands around 18, still above 15; the `is not var (path, receiver, middle)` deconstruction on a nullable tuple and the re-derived `verb = t[i + 2].Text` also risk a build error or a behaviour change, and I couldn't check either against the full file or a build because the source isn't in this environment.
